voices.title: Voices from the Floor
voices.description: Straight from the people who build Ripplr every day.

featured.quote: As a designer, Ripplr has taught me that good design isn't just about how a product looks - it's about making complex operations simpler for the people who use them every day, from the warehouse floor to the field.
featured.name: Suresh

secondary.quote: At Ripplr, we obsess over users to build meaningful products that improve lives and drive business efficiently.
secondary.name: Rohit

secondary.quote: What stands out at Ripplr is the freedom to take a problem from zero to solved - you don't just learn product thinking here, you live it.
secondary.name: Kartik Palkurtiwar

featured.quote: My journey at Ripplr has taken me from Application Support to Data Analytics, built on continuous learning and growth. Along the way, I've developed strong skills in SQL, Power BI, and Python to solve real business problems through data.
featured.name: Sudarshan Shetty

secondary.quote: At Ripplr, I grew from Customer Success to Tech Engineer, resolving critical issues, and improving operational efficiency through technology.
secondary.name: Jeevan N

secondary.quote: Working with great leaders turns challenges into opportunities and visions into reality.
secondary.name: Ayub Pasha

featured.quote: Working at Ripplr has been an incredible journey, enabling me to build impactful data solutions alongside some truly exceptional minds.
featured.name: Akshatha HT

secondary.quote: From customer queries to production issues - I troubleshoot, solve, learn, and somehow keep everything running.
secondary.name: Praveen P

secondary.quote: Ripplr has been a platform for refining my skills and providing valuable insights on teamwork and dynamic work environment.
secondary.name: Chiranjeevi H G

featured.quote: A company's true value isn't just in its balance sheet - it's in the vision it pursues, the problems it solves, and the trust it earns over time.
featured.name: Kishor AM

secondary.quote: A workplace filled with a supportive and collaborative environment.
secondary.name: Arti Rungta

secondary.quote: In logistics, finance ensures efficiency isn't just fast - it's profitable and sustainable.
secondary.name: Sowkya Suresh

featured.quote: Working with Ripplr has been a catalyst for excellence, innovation, and transformative leadership in supply chain.
featured.name: Shashi Kumar

secondary.quote: Working with great leaders turns challenges into opportunities and visions into reality.
secondary.name: Pavan Kumar

secondary.quote: Being surrounded by inspiring leaders and passionate individuals has constantly pushed me to grow, stay curious, and aim higher in my career.
secondary.name: Sheik Muddasir

featured.quote: Leading finance at Ripplr has been an incredible journey of blending financial discipline with rapid supply chain scale. Managing unit economics and cash flow in a tech-driven logistics environment challenges you to think strategically every day.
featured.name: Chetan

secondary.quote: Ripplr's supportive environment makes it a great place to work and grow. I enjoy working with the team and growing my skills.
secondary.name: Amrit Kumar

secondary.quote: I enjoy working with data, solving business challenges, learning something new every day. What makes Ripplr special is the opportunity to grow, collaborate.
secondary.name: Abhishek Chand

featured.quote: Ripplr provides a dynamic and fast-paced work environment where individuals are given opportunities to take on new responsibilities and expand their skills. The collaborative culture, supportive leadership, and cross-functional exposure have helped me strengthen my commercial and operational expertise.
featured.name: Appasab Narawade

secondary.quote: Ripplr has been a journey of continuous learning and growth. I'm grateful for the people, support, and opportunities that help me grow every day.
secondary.name: Govindaraju KM

secondary.quote: Ripplr is a place to learn, take on challenges, and build a meaningful career - with the support and opportunities to grow.
secondary.name: Venkatesh K

featured.quote: Ripplr has been my first company in Bangalore and an incredible learning journey. It taught me ownership, responsibility, and the confidence to grow. I'm grateful to my managers and seniors for their constant support and guidance. Proud to have witnessed Ripplr's growth and to be a part of its journey.
featured.name: Preeti Swain

secondary.quote: Ripplr has given me many opportunities to learn new things & improve my skills. I'm happy to be part of the Ripplr family and look forward to growing together.
secondary.name: Bhavana

secondary.quote: Ripplr is giving me good exposure towards brand handling and future scope of involving in to business with other top Brands.
secondary.name: Sunil Kumar S
